thread:
Morgan: heads-up — large batch of GPU pods Pending in eu-west-2 since the early morning roll, looks like packing skew across nodepools
Morgan: most of them are small fractional requests (0.25/0.5) with nodeSelector: gpu-type=nvidia-a10 and strict podAntiAffinity to avoid colocations
Morgan: kubectl describe shows a FitFailure that reads 'InsufficientNVIDIAGPU' even though nodes report spare fractional capacity
Morgan: snippet:
```
Events:
  Type     Reason            Age   From               Message
  ----     ------            ----  ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling  2m    default-scheduler  0/24 nodes are available: 12 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu, 8 node(s) didn't match pod anti-affinity, 4 MatchNodeSelector.
```
Akshat: is this the new spot-mix nodepool we added last week? sounds like labels/taints mismatch or CA not scaling the ondemand pool
Lina: yep, that nodepool has mixed allocatable due to MIG/driver config divergence. Some nodes report 1xA10 allocatable, others 8x smaller slices. CA is seeing capacity but the scheduler's fit probe rejects because pod has strict selector
Rafael: can you paste the pod spec? maybe the requests/limits are using gpu resource name variations like nvidia.com/gpu vs accelerator.com/gpu
Morgan: pasted pod yaml in thread:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: sampler-rl-5
spec:
  nodeSelector:
    gpu-type: nvidia-a10
  containers:
  - name: worker
    resources:
      limits:
        nvidia.com/gpu: "0.25"
    args: ["--batch", "64"]
  affinity:
    podAntiAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      - labelSelector:
          matchExpressions:
          - key: app
            operator: In
            values: [sampler]
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
```
Priya: scheduler doesn't support fractional GPUs as a resource - those are synthetic. We're using device plugin that exposes fractional slices via extended resources, but CA/fit path treats them as atomic sometimes. Also anti-affinity is blocking co-locating slices on the same physical board
Jun: Ops note: eu-west-2 currently has spot pressure after the weekend; CA is scaling the spot pool up but our ondemand reserved pool is still at minSize. If pods require co-locating multiple slices on same node (due to allocatable shapes) they'll wait for ondemand nodes
Akshat: short-term fix: relax the nodeSelector to accept both a10-small and a10-large labels and remove required podAntiAffinity for the cheap batch jobs. That should allow CA to binpack across both subpools
Lina: alternative: add a scheduling policy that prefers packing small-slice pods onto nodes with free slices (use topologySpreadConstraints + soft affinity) so we don't blow up co-location constraints
Rafael: longer term: we should standardize allocatable shapes across the spot mix and ensure the device plugin maps the same resource name. Also add a CA scale-up trigger for "fractional-slice-demand" alert
Morgan: cost note: relaxing anti-affinity will increase packing density and reduce spot churn, saving ~20% on these workloads. But we need to be careful for noisy-neighbor cases
